title: Breathtaking experience
text:
What a great day we had skiing around in the mountains with our amazing guide Christian.
After our hotel pick up we straight went to Andorra and began this wonderful journey. Everything went great and we even had extra options to visit highlights such as the Caldea (that was totally worth it btw) and Christian's energy and attitude just made our experience even better! It's a long day but you will not regret it as you are spending it in the best possible ways! To all fellows ski and mountains lovers, do not hesitate and book this trip! Thank you Christian !!!
author: Inspire03273609144

title: What a nice day!
text: A perfect guided trip, from the start till the happy ending!
author: Safari726298

title: Incredible Ski Experience
text:
Christian was an absolutely amazing guide. The ski tour was incredibly well organized, especially considering that for us it was a last-minute, spontaneous plan — we honestly didn’t expect to end up skiing in Barcelona, and it turned out to be the best decision.

His attention was excellent, everything ran smoothly, and the experience was engaging and fun from start to finish. We really couldn’t recommend him more. Thanks again for turning this unexpected plan to one of the highlights of our January in Barcelona!
author: 688lenaa

title: Amazing ski experience with Christian
text: It was a great different day! Very well organised, and we even added going to the spa which was a great ending of a ski day. Just watch out! Because Andorra, small as it is, really is another country, and you'll not have signal on your phone until you get back to Spain!
author: victoriahL7128IB

title: Journey I will repeat 100%
text: I traveled in April 2025 and it was a super cool experience!! Everything was great organized from the moment we left Barcelona, the departure and return. Christian was super friendly and attentive and made the experience unbeatable. It is definitely worth doing if you can take advantage of your trip to Barcelona, it is a MUST if you like skiing😍
